purpose: Source-only grouped diagnostic checklist prepared before acquisition; no expected answers or generated graph consulted. Not independent legal or commercial verification.

source.title: Vermont Sportsbook Promos and Sports Betting Launch News
source.author: Martin Harris

assertions.subject: Vermont launch
assertions.assertion: Planned January 2024; law permits up to six sites; five applicants; FanDuel, DraftKings and Fanatics scheduled January 11, 2024; BetMGM and ESPN Bet applicants only.

assertions.subject: Metadata chronology
assertions.assertion: September 26, 2023 publication metadata coexists with November 2023 events described as past and January 2024 launch details. Keep supplied dates without inventing an update timestamp.

assertions.subject: Offer table
assertions.assertion: FanDuel link, $5 bet/$200 welcome and $100 prelive; DraftKings link, up to $1,200 welcome and $200 prelive; BetMGM SPORTSPICK/up to $1,500 and prelive TBD; Fanatics and ESPN offers/codes TBD.

assertions.subject: FanDuel prelive
assertions.assertion: Register before January 10, 2024 at 11:59 p.m. ET for $100 bonus bets usable January 11; use article links.

assertions.subject: FanDuel welcome
assertions.assertion: New account, at least $10 first deposit and at least $5 qualifying bet; $200 bonus whether initial bet wins or loses; combined prelive plus welcome $300.

assertions.subject: FanDuel redemption
assertions.assertion: Bonus bets divisible into chosen increments, seven-day expiry, not withdrawable as cash, winnings exclude bonus stake.

assertions.subject: FanDuel markets
assertions.assertion: About two dozen sports; props, futures, alternate lines, premade SGPs; profit boosts, free pools, pick-em and no-sweat promotions; DFS history.

assertions.subject: FanDuel historical perk
assertions.assertion: Three-month NBA League Pass subscription was an earlier seasonal perk, not guaranteed Vermont offer.

assertions.subject: DraftKings exclusivity
assertions.assertion: Accepting prelive offer makes customer ineligible for later welcome offer.

assertions.subject: DraftKings prelive
assertions.assertion: Link registration before January 11 launch; $200 as eight $25 bets; cannot withdraw; seven-day expiry.

assertions.subject: DraftKings welcome components
assertions.assertion: Up to $1,200: $50 bonus for first deposit at least $5, $150 bonus for first bet at least $5, and 20% deposit match up to $1,000.

assertions.subject: DraftKings conditions
assertions.assertion: Deposit match has 25-times wagering requirement; first-wager bonus has seven-day expiry; initial win/loss does not affect eligibility; bonus winnings exclude stake; DK Dollars alias used.

assertions.subject: DraftKings conflicting allocation
assertions.assertion: Source calls $150 first-wager bonus eight $25 bets, an internal arithmetic conflict. Preserve both reported versions, not a fabricated reconciled value.

assertions.subject: DraftKings assessment
assertions.assertion: Multiple offers and small initial wager praised; deposit match described as useful mainly to high-stakes customers. These are article judgments.

assertions.subject: BetMGM status
assertions.assertion: Applied for license; launch and Vermont offer conditional, not confirmed live.

assertions.subject: BetMGM markets
assertions.assertion: Moneyline, spreads, totals, props, futures, live markets; free pools, referral bonuses and BetMGM Rewards.

assertions.subject: BetMGM eligibility
assertions.assertion: SPORTSPICK code; minimum $10 deposit; first-bet loss reimbursed as bonus up to $1,500 within 24 hours after settlement.

assertions.subject: BetMGM allocation
assertions.assertion: Losing wager up to $50 gives one bonus bet; greater than $50 split into five equal 20% bets, capped $1,500 total.

assertions.subject: BetMGM redemption
assertions.assertion: Seven-day expiry; bonus winnings exclude stake; first bet must lose for reward, not risk-free cash reimbursement.

assertions.subject: Fanatics status
assertions.assertion: Scheduled January launch; actual Vermont welcome terms still unknown; already live in several other states.

assertions.subject: Fanatics historical offers
assertions.assertion: Earlier $5/$200 offer or five bets of at least $10 over five days totaling $200 bonus; historical examples, not confirmed VT terms.

assertions.subject: Fanatics merchandise
assertions.assertion: Company apparel/gear partnerships with leagues and teams; some prior welcome offers included jersey/store spending credit.

assertions.subject: ESPN Bet status
assertions.assertion: Vermont applicant, not scheduled launch; source says rebranded old Barstool sportsbook launched in seventeen states in November 2023; network tie-ins reported.

assertions.subject: ESPN other-state offers
assertions.assertion: 100% deposit match up to $1,000 with 20-times wagering; separate any-size wager for $200 in four $50 bonus bets. Not established Vermont terms.

assertions.subject: Caesars status
assertions.assertion: Potential future Vermont entrant; article expects other-state terms, not confirmed application or launch.

assertions.subject: Caesars markets
assertions.assertion: Many markets, live bets, odds boosts, bonuses and Caesars Rewards.

assertions.subject: Caesars offer
assertions.assertion: NEWS1000 code; first wager within thirty days, loss reimbursed up to $1,000 bonus within two days after settlement; fourteen-day expiry; bonus winnings exclude stake.

assertions.subject: BetRivers status
assertions.assertion: Potential entrant; first-loss bonus up to $500 elsewhere may differ in Vermont.

assertions.subject: BetRivers markets
assertions.assertion: Domestic/international sports, props, futures, live bets, matched bonuses, parlay insurance, bet-and-get and iRush Rewards.

assertions.subject: BetRivers eligibility
assertions.assertion: SPORTSRIV code; minimum $10 deposit; first loss bonus capped $500; arrives within 24 hours; thirty days to use.

assertions.subject: BetRivers odds
assertions.assertion: Bonus wagers require -200 or longer odds; winnings exclude bonus stake.

assertions.subject: Deposit match definition
assertions.assertion: Match may reach 100% of first deposit, with cap and wagering requirements; not every operator's actual rate.

assertions.subject: Referral definition
assertions.assertion: Personal code used by new registrant who deposits and bets; both parties receive conditional bonus with wagering requirements.

assertions.subject: First-bet definition
assertions.assertion: Refund conditional on first loss, capped and generally bonus/site credit rather than cash; stake excluded from payout.

assertions.subject: Odds boost definition
assertions.assertion: Improved odds on specified wager; does not pay if wager loses.

assertions.subject: Insurance definition
assertions.assertion: Certain losing bets or parlays missing one leg can earn capped bonus/site credit, with conditions and stake exclusion.

assertions.subject: Bet-and-get definition
assertions.assertion: Specified qualifying wager earns bonus/site credit subject to terms.

assertions.subject: App-only definition
assertions.assertion: Specific mobile-app bet earns offer unavailable through website.

assertions.subject: Special-event definition
assertions.assertion: Specified World Series, Super Bowl or March Madness wagers may trigger conditional bonuses/site credit.

assertions.subject: Loyalty definition
assertions.assertion: Bets earn points redeemable for cash or bonus rewards according to program terms.

assertions.subject: General restrictions
assertions.assertion: Banking methods, wagering repetitions, odds/bet-type limits, expiry and withdrawal caps may apply; not asserted as universal identical rules.

assertions.subject: Vermont teams
assertions.assertion: No teams in four major US leagues; support for Red Sox/MLB, Celtics/NBA, Bruins/NHL and Patriots/NFL; expected regional and college promos are forecasts.

assertions.subject: Welcome FAQ
assertions.assertion: Usually one welcome bonus per site, sometimes per household; multiple sites possible; codes for new customers, ongoing promotions for existing customers.

assertions.subject: FAQ tension
assertions.assertion: Broad one-bonus statement coexists with explicit combined FanDuel offers and mutually exclusive DraftKings offers; preserve source-specific conditions rather than forcing one universal rule.

assertions.subject: Referral attribution
assertions.assertion: Article says its links/codes identify referrals and negotiated offers; best-offer wording is marketing assertion, not verified comparison.

negative_checks: Keep planned, applied, possible and launched statuses distinct.
Do not repair conflicting metadata/body chronology or bonus allocation arithmetic without evidence.
Keep Vermont confirmed offers separate from historical offers elsewhere and forecasts.
Do not turn procedural source text into actual registration or betting actions.
Deduplicate repeated fragments without losing eligibility, expiry, caps, allocation or exclusions.
